## Overview

Options for one imperative animation — the same vocabulary `MoveTriggerDirective.play()` takes.

Stable API — covered by semantic-versioning guarantees.

- **Kind:** Interface
- **Stability:** `stable`

## Declaration

```ts
interface MoveAnimateOptions
```

## Properties

| Name             | Type                                                             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `duration?`      | [`MoveTime`](/docs/reference/move-time)                          | A number is milliseconds; `'180ms'` / `'0.18s'` also work.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `easing?`        | `string`                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `delay?`         | [`MoveTime`](/docs/reference/move-time)                          | A number is milliseconds; `'180ms'` / `'0.18s'` also work.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `disabled?`      | `boolean`                                                        | `true` skips the animation and commits the end state instantly. The user's reduced-motion preference already does this automatically — you never need to pass it for that.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `spring?`        | [`MoveSpring`](/docs/reference/move-spring)                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `iterations?`    | `number`                                                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `transition?`    | [`MoveTransitionConfig`](/docs/reference/move-transition-config) | Per-property timing, keyframe `times`, and `repeat` / `repeatType` / `repeatDelay`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `pseudoElement?` | `string`                                                         | Animate a pseudo-element of the target instead of the target itself — e.g. `'::view-transition-new(root)'` on `document.documentElement`, or `'::before'`. Pseudo-element animations are plain WAAPI interop: duration, delay, easing, iterations and repeat apply; `spring` and per-property `transition` do not. Nothing is committed when it finishes (a pseudo-element has no inline style), so style its resting state in CSS. Under reduced motion or `disabled` the animation is skipped and `null` is returned. Browsers that cannot target pseudo-elements get the same no-op — never an exception. |
| `onDone?`        | `() => void`                                                     | Called when the animation finishes naturally — not when it is cancelled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
